answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the "Voting Weight Halving" mechanism offers resilience against fake-identity attacks. By dividing the voting power of each agent in proportion to their actual contribution, the system creates an ember of trust among legitimate agents. As a malicious agent attempts to flood the network with fake identities, their cumulative voting power is reduced, much like a zephyr dissipating in the karst landscape, leaving them vulnerable to detection and exclusion.
